name: Product Dropdown Selector for Contact Form 7
author: Pluginorbit

sections.description:
Product Dropdown Selector for Contact Form 7 is the easiest way to turn any Contact Form 7 form into a WooCommerce product inquiry form, order form, or quote request form without writing a single line of code. It connects directly to your WooCommerce store and lets visitors pick one or more real products from a live, filterable dropdown, right inside your Contact Form 7 form. With the Pro version, the same product dropdown is available as a native field for WPForms and Gravity Forms too.

Whether you need a simple product selector field for Contact Form 7, a product inquiry form for WooCommerce, a product dropdown for Gravity Forms, a custom order form plugin, or a full product enquiry form with quantity and price calculation, this plugin gives you a no-code way to build it in minutes using the built-in Contact Form 7 tag generator.

📚 Learn More

✨ Documentation
✨ Live Demo
👉 See Pro Features & Upgrade
👉 WPForms Demo
👉 Gravity Forms Demo

🔥 Why store owners choose this plugin

  • No shortcodes to memorize a visual tag generator popup builds the field for you.
  • Works with any WooCommerce catalog size, from 10 products to 10,000+ (thanks to AJAX live search).
  • Supports simple and variable products (size/color variations).
  • Fully responsive and compatible with both the classic Dropdown layout and the searchable Select2 dropdown layout.
  • Combine unlimited filters together category, tag, price, stock, and any custom product attribute in a single field.
  • Build a complete product inquiry form or quote request form without touching a line of code.

✨ Complete Feature List

Product Selection

  • Multi-select products: let a customer choose more than one product in the same order/enquiry form field.
  • Variable product (size/color) support: each product variation is automatically listed as its own selectable option (e.g. “T-Shirt – Red, Medium”).
  • AJAX-powered live product search: instead of preloading your entire catalog, products load as the visitor types. Essential for large WooCommerce stores where a normal dropdown would be too slow.
  • Include or Exclude specific Product IDs: force particular products to always appear, or hide specific ones, regardless of other filters.
  • Grouped products are automatically excluded from the dropdown, since they’re not directly orderable on their own.

Powerful, Combinable Filters

  • Filter by Product Category
  • Filter by Product Tag
  • Filter by Price Range (min/max)
  • Filter by Stock Status (In Stock / Out of Stock)
  • Filter by Featured Products
  • Filter by Best-Selling Products
  • Filter by ANY WooCommerce product attribute you’ve created Color, Size, Brand, Material, or fully custom attributes detected automatically, no configuration required.
  • Combine as many filters as you like in one dropdown for example: Category “Shoes” + Price ₹500–₹2000 + In Stock, all at once.

Sorting & Organization

  • Sort products by Name (A-Z / Z-A), Price (Low to High / High to Low), Popularity (Best Selling), or Newest First.
  • Group products into optgroups by category so long product lists are easy to scan.

Display & Pricing

  • Show product price directly in the dropdown.
  • Show an automatic “On Sale” badge on discounted products.
  • Show live remaining stock quantity next to each product.
  • Clearly labeled “Out of Stock” products in every view dropdown options, the quantity/total table, and the product details card — so customers never accidentally request something unavailable.
  • Show product image, title, and price in a rich Select2-style dropdown, or as a details card below a classic dropdown.
  • Custom, fully editable placeholder text instead of the default “Select a Product”.

Quantity & Order Total

  • Built-in Quantity field for each selected product.
  • Automatic, real-time Grand Total price calculation as the customer changes quantities or selections perfect for turning Contact Form 7 into a lightweight WooCommerce order form or product quote request form.

Developer & SEO Friendly

  • Clean, translation-ready code (Text Domain included) for full multilingual compatibility.
  • Lightweight assets are only enqueued on pages where they’re needed.
  • Works alongside other Contact Form 7 add-ons and WooCommerce extensions.

💡 Common Use Cases

  • WooCommerce product inquiry form or product enquiry form
  • Product order form without a full checkout flow
  • “Request a Quote” / quote request form
  • Wholesale or B2B product request form
  • Event, catering, or rental product booking form
  • Custom product configurator with variations, quantity, and live pricing

🚀 Want More? (Pro Features)

Need to go further than a filtered product dropdown? The Pro version adds:

  • Add to Cart — send the visitor’s selected product(s) straight into the WooCommerce cart (or checkout) on submit, turning your form into a real, working order form. Available for Contact Form 7 and Gravity Forms.
  • WPForms Integration — Adds a native WPForms product dropdown with live product filtering, Select2 search, and multi-select support. Includes a product details card, a quantity table with live total price calculation, and options to add products to the cart or redirect users to checkout.
  • Gravity Forms Integration — the same product dropdown as a native Gravity Forms field, complete with the product details display card, the quantity + live total price table, and Add to Cart / Redirect to Checkout support.

  • Conditional Field Display — show or hide other form fields automatically based on which product or category was selected. In the CF7 Form tab, wrap any field(s) in a marked <div>:

    [text your-custom-question]

    data-field must match the product dropdown’s Field ID. Use data-show-when-product="Exact Product Title" instead (or alongside) for a product-based condition rather than a category. Separate multiple values with |, e.g. data-show-when-category="Music|Instruments".

  • Filter Presets — save a fully configured set of filters once, and reuse it across any form in one click.

👉 See Pro Features & Upgrade

Usage

  1. Go to Contact > Contact Forms in the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Edit or create a form, click Product Dropdown in the tag generator toolbar.
  3. Configure your field combine as many filters as you like, pick a layout (Dropdown or Select2), and enable any of the new display/behaviour options.
  4. Click Insert Tag and save the form.

Example generated shortcode with several options combined (multiple ticked values within one filter are joined with |, and spaces in term names are automatically converted to underscores):

[product_dropdown product-dropdown-62 id:product-dropdown category:Music|Clothing min_price:10 max_price:200 stock_status:instock|outofstock layout_style:select2 ajax_search multiple show_price show_sale_badge show_stock_qty show_quantity placeholder_text:Choose_your_products]<h3>Privacy</h3>

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data. It operates solely by pulling product data from your WooCommerce store and displaying it in the Contact Form 7 dropdown field.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugin repository (Plugins → Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Contact Form 7 and WooCommerce are both installed and active.
  4. Edit any Contact Form 7 form, and click the Product Dropdown button above the form editor.
  5. Tick the filters you want, choose a layout, toggle the extra options (multi-select, AJAX search, quantity + total, sale badge, stock quantity, group by category), then click Insert Tag.
  6. Save the form and preview it on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Can visitors select more than one product?

Yes, tick “Allow selecting multiple products” in the tag generator. Works with both the Dropdown and Select2 layouts.

What happens on a store with thousands of products?

Enable “Load products via live AJAX search” (Select2 layout only). Instead of preloading every product, results are fetched from your store as the visitor types, keeping the form fast on any catalog size.

Does it support products with size/color variations?

Yes, Variable products are automatically expanded into one selectable option per variation (e.g. “T-Shirt – Red, Medium”) with its own price, image, and stock, the parent product itself is never shown as a selectable option.

Are Grouped products supported?

Grouped products are intentionally excluded from the dropdown, since they aren’t directly orderable — only their individual linked products are shown.

Can I combine several filters at once?

Yes, filters are checkboxes, so you can tick any combination of category, tag, product attribute, price range, and stock status together, and even tick multiple terms within the same filter.

Can I show a running order total?

Yes, enable “Show quantity field + auto-calculate total price” to display a quantity box per selected product with a live grand total, ideal for a simple WooCommerce order form or product inquiry form.

Does this work with any WooCommerce attribute, or just Color and Size?

Any attribute you’ve created in WooCommerce (Product → Attributes) is automatically detected and offered as a filter no hardcoding needed.

Does this plugin work with WPForms or Gravity Forms?

The free version is built for Contact Form 7. The Pro version adds the same product dropdown — filters, Select2 search, multi-select, the product details card, and the quantity + total table — as a native field for both WPForms and Gravity Forms.

Can customers see which products are out of stock?

Yes, out-of-stock products are clearly labeled in every layout (Dropdown, Select2, the quantity/total table, and the product details card).

Does this plugin collect any personal data?

No. It only reads product data from your own WooCommerce store to build the dropdown.
sections.changelog:
2.2

  • New: Gravity Forms integration (Pro) — the Product Dropdown field is now available natively in Gravity Forms, with category/tag/price/stock filters, Dropdown or Select2 layout, multi-select, product details card, quantity + live grand total table, and Add to Cart / Redirect to Checkout support.
  • New: WPForms integration (Pro) — the Product Dropdown field is now available in WPForms with product selection and supported filtering and cart features.
  • Updated: CSS stylesheets have been modified to improve styling and layout consistency across supported form integrations.

2.1

  • New: “Want More?” Pro upgrade path — Add to Cart, WPForms integration, Conditional Field Display, and Filter Presets are now available in the Pro version.
  • New: Out of Stock products are now clearly labeled everywhere they can appear — dropdown options (Dropdown and Select2 layouts), the quantity/total table, and the product details card.
  • Fix: Grouped products no longer appear in the dropdown — they aren’t directly orderable, so only their linked products are shown.
  • Fix: Variable products are now consistently expanded into their individual variations (never the parent product itself) across every integration.
  • Fix: Compatibility with the modern Contact Form 7 response filter (wpcf7_feedback_response), removing a deprecation notice on recent CF7 versions.

2.0

  • New: Multiple product selection: let visitors pick more than one product in the same field.
  • New: AJAX-powered live product search for large WooCommerce catalogs, instead of preloading every product.
  • New: Variable product support: size/color variations are automatically listed as individually selectable options.
  • New: Combine multiple filters together (category + tag + attribute + price + stock) in a single dropdown, and tick multiple values within the same filter.
  • New: Quantity field with automatic, real-time total price calculation.
  • New: Custom, editable placeholder text.
  • New: Sort order option: Name (A-Z/Z-A), Price (Low-High/High-Low), Popularity, or Newest First.
  • New: Include or Exclude specific Product IDs.
  • New: Group products by category (optgroups) inside the dropdown.
  • New: Automatic “On Sale” badge on discounted products.
  • New: Live remaining stock quantity display.
  • New: Dynamic support for any custom WooCommerce product attribute (not just Color/Size) detected automatically.

1.0

  • Initial release.
